WRITTEN IN LEAN 4

No Swift. One language, top to bottom.

01 · The wallet

Bitcoin in Lean

Keys, transactions, PSBTs, descriptors, compact-filter sync, peers and broadcast are Lean 4 compiled to C. Every key and signature runs on one secp256k1, proved in Lean against the curve as specified.

02 · The app

Model, update, view

Each screen is a Lean function from the wallet’s state. Standard iOS controls draw it, through an Objective-C shell that is itself printed from Lean at build time.

03 · The framework

LeanNative

Keychain, Face ID, Bluetooth, iCloud and background tasks reach Lean as typed capabilities. The Xcode project is generated from a Lean description of the app, which refuses a permission without its explanation.
